evidence.quote: I think that's part of this experience of velocity sickness is we're building things that are not

evidence.quote: The third problem you might be experiencing is declaring agent bankruptcy.

evidence.quote: Doing a lot of your work, if you as an engineer are letting an agent make a critical decision, you are ceding control of your code.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: You are no longer the owner of that code, the agent is.

evidence.quote: At some point, an agent takes that idea and implements it.

evidence.quote: And then in the end we do some polishing where we take back that thing the agent has made for us and we hold it in our hands and we say, is this what I wanted?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So being in this isolated environment where I'm working with an agent, maybe I start with my vague idea and I'm exploring it and asking questions, but decisions are being made in that chat that are not shared with my team that are gonna disappear as long, I'm gonna result in some code being output where those important decisions are not being made clear and shared with the team.

evidence.quote: And you're also in this mode where the agent's saying,

evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: So when you're living and working in a long-lived session with an agent, there's this implicit context being built up over that work, and that's great.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: What you want is to separate the agent as the action and the doc as the state.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 上下文工程 (context engineering)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成是在文档中精细管理共享上下文的方法，让多个新智能体基于同一份状态无状态地工作

evidence.quote: You're ultimately doing context engineering in this doc.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 状态 (state)
entities.how_described: 本集提出「状态与动作分离」，把智能体当作动作、把文档当作共享且持久的状态，以取代孤立的聊天上下文

evidence.quote: But the big conceptual flip here is actually that we're pulling out the state.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: What you want is to separate the agent as the action and the doc as the state.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: That are able to collaborate and work on this same piece of context and state.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: Now you understand the state of this project and you can pick up from there.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

evidence.quote: There are also some other benefits, so when you have this state extracted and you're working from a shared context, you get more parallel agents, it's easier to work with parallel agents, you get this durable decision log, so something that's really powerful.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00

entities.name: 原型重力 (prototype gravity)
entities.how_described: 本集把它说成是做出一点东西就兴奋地想赶紧发布的惯性；解法是从代码速度转向想法速度，多探索几条路径再发布

evidence.quote: is to shift that velocity to ideas so that rather than getting stuck in prototype gravity where we build something and we're so excited to just ship that thing and we're going down one path of the idea maze, we can now more effectively explore that whole maze and find that gold that's around the corner and really impact the people we're trying to help.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_00
